verdict.rationale: Jan is an open-source project hosted on GitHub, and its README includes build-from-source instructions ("installs dependencies, builds core components, and launches the app"), so outside developers could plausibly contribute code. However, the evidence never documents a contribution process or any path to becoming a recognized collaborator. Missing for 10: CONTRIBUTING guidelines or PR process, license details, contributor or maintainer recognition, evidence of community contributions being accepted, governance documentation.
